decisions.reason: As a cloud contact centre service it builds directly on the firm's existing contact-centre, cloud and managed-service capabilities, so high absorptive capacity and the firm's expansion strategy make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

The call number routing platform is very close to the firm's core network and voice competencies, and with strong internal technical resources and clear strategic fit the firm would likely keep and improve it rather than exit after only a short time on the market.
